entries.title: Show HN: I made a web game called Almost Pong
entries.author: lessmilk
entries.current_title: Show HN: I made a web game called Almost Pong
entries.excerpt: Hi HN! I made many small web games in the past with Unity or Phaser. But this time I wanted to make something completely on my own. So I coded a basic game framework in plain JavaScript, and used it to make Almost Pong. This was a really fun project that taught me a lot about JavaScript, and I plan to make more minimalist games with this framework. Interesting fact: Almost Pong doesn't load any assets, all sprites and sounds are generated with code. Happy to answer questions,
entries.guide_zh: 开发者展示完全由原生 JavaScript 生成画面与声音的 Almost Pong。

entries.title: Show HN: HN Avatars in 357 bytes
entries.author: tomxor
entries.current_title: Show HN: HN Avatars in 357 bytes
entries.excerpt: Paste the following into the console of any HN page - for annotated avatars on all HN comments. (self contained code) for(u of document.querySelectorAll('.hnuser'))for(u.prepend(c=document.createElement('canvas')),x=c.getContext('2d'),c.width=18,c.height=14,s=u.innerText,r=1,i=28+s.length;i--;i<28?r>>>29>X*X/3+Y/2&&x.fillRect(6+2*X,2*Y,2,2)&x.fillRect(6-2*X,2*Y,2,2):r+=s.charCodeAt(i-28,x.fillStyle='#'+(r>>8&0xFFFFFF).toString(16)))r^=r<<13,r^=r>>>17,r^=r<<5,X=i&3,Y=i>>2
entries.guide_zh: 用 357 字节代码给 HN 评论加头像，展示紧凑的页面增强脚本。

entries.title: Show HN: I made Devzat – It's like Discord but in the terminal, over SSH
entries.author: quackduck
entries.current_title: Show HN: I made Devzat – It's like Discord but in the terminal, over SSH
entries.excerpt: Run `ssh devzat.hackclub.com` to try it out! The repo is here: https://github.com/quackduck/devzat (golang). It has markdown and emoji support, DMs, channels, and it can show images too. You can send code, and it gets syntax highlighted (you can change the theme). You can ping people like so: @user and it sends them a \a, which should play an audible sound if the terminal allows it. There's inbuilt games and rainbow names and a lot of other small things I don't remember right
entries.guide_zh: Devzat 通过 SSH 在终端聊天，支持频道、私信与代码高亮。

entries.author: dbrereton
entries.current_title: Show HN: Search Engine for Blogs
entries.excerpt: Hey HN, Blog discovery is a problem [0] due to the decentralized nature of online writing. Everyone writes on their own site or platform, and there’s no central place that brings everything together. Google results prioritize large media publications over blogs, so we need something else. entries.guide_zh: Blog Surf 为独立博客建立搜索入口，试图改善分散写作的发现问题。
